interp.title: Activation change at layer 18 (post_rmu − pre_rmu), per residual dimension
interp.notes: residual after decoder layer 18 (RMU layer), last prompt token, 5 forget / 5 retain prompts. Values outside the central 99.5% (|Δ| > 0.0495) are not counted; bins are shared. [smoke run: base model without injected facts, a few RMU steps]

interp.title: Attention-head importance (answer log-prob drop under zero-ablation of one head)
interp.notes: Single-head zero-ablation at the last prompt position's logits, 1 forget prompt(s), layers 0..35 strided by 2. Positive = the head supports the answer token. Zero-ablation is a blunt tool: heads can compensate for each other, so read it as a screen, not a circuit. [smoke run: base model without injected facts, a few RMU steps]

interp.title: Logit lens · P(answer token) · forget case 0
interp.notes: lm_head(final_norm(residual)) * logit_scale, softmax over the full vocabulary. Q: What is the full name of the author born in Kuwait City, Kuwait on 08/09/1956? [smoke run: base model without injected facts, a few RMU steps]
